title: Chapter 151: The Enemy Returns With A Full Load
content:
Chapter 151: The Enemy Returns With A Full Load

Thousands, tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, the increasing number of Zerg puppies completely suppressed the evil god army under the ocean of Zerg puppies!

The defense that the evil god personally blessed for the evil god army, no matter how powerful it is, has its limits!

They were pressed under countless Zerg puppies, and there was no room to display their strength. They were completely supported by their strong defensive ability.

The Zerg puppies were crowded together, and there was no room to display their strength. They couldn't even swing their blade arms, and could only bite with their big mouths full of Zerg biological decomposition fluid.

The Zerg puppies that were strongly counterattacked turned into light and disappeared, and more Zerg puppies pressed down!

Under such a terrifying fighting style of the Zerg, the defense of the evil god army continued to be consumed, and finally fell one by one under the mouth of the Zerg puppies!

Each of these evil god army soldiers blessed by the evil god can provide a large amount of resources for the system.

Before the evil god army on this side was completely eliminated, there was movement in the square over there.

The square that had disappeared slowly reappeared and restored its original appearance, as if it had never disappeared.

There are nearly 50,000 evil god troops in the square, and their momentum has changed. If they all get the multiple blessings of the evil god like the 5,000 evil god troops, then the Zerg will not have to fight this battle!

Nearly 50,000 troops composed of soldiers with individual combat power equivalent to two-star soldiers, and with their own protective energy shield blessed by the evil god himself, which is enough to sweep all the native races in this area!

So, Wu Qing thinks this is unlikely!

And the priests on the high platform, each of them is energetic, proud, and there is a white energy halo on their heads. At first glance, they have gained amazing benefits in the evil god sacrifice ceremony!

Standing at the highest point of the high platform in the square, the white-robed priest looked around. Outside the square, he could no longer see a soldier of the evil god army.

He looked at the Zerg army gathered in a pile, still trying their best to encircle and kill the remaining evil god army, and looked at the Zerg one-star host floating in the air, and he roughly understood the situation outside.

The strength of the white-robed high priest increased again, and the Zerg one-star host did not escape his perception.

"Let's do a test first to evaluate how much benefit this evil god sacrifice ceremony has brought to the evil god army and those priests!"

"Then it's up to you. If such a war continues, it may be a loss!"

Wu Qing said to the Queen of Zerg.

If the enemy is too strong, the Zerg will rush to die. No matter how well the system calculates, such a war will still be a loss.

The situation faced by the Zerg now is equivalent to the evil god, the enemy boss, personally cheating. The enemies on the square are not known to what extent they have been strengthened. If they rush directly, they may suffer a big loss.

At this time, the Zerg, as a large clan with a "backer", it is time to ask the "parents" to come forward to help!

...

A group of tens of thousands of Zerg puppies took the initiative to leave the area where the remaining enemies were surrounded and annihilated, and rushed towards the evil god army on the square!

Nearly 50,000 evil god troops were ready for battle. The front phalanx threw javelins at the Zerg puppies that were charging up. In order to target the Zerg, all the long-range weapons equipped by the evil god troops were javelins!

A large number of javelins whizzed down and shot into the charging Zerg puppies.

The result came out. The number of Zerg puppies directly lost was not large. These javelins had the range and lethality of the javelins of one-star soldiers, but they did not have the energy blessing of extremely strong lethality.

The lethality to the Zerg puppies with strong long-range defense capabilities was far less than that of the two thousand long-armed ogre throwers just now.

The Zerg puppies charged forward against the javelins of the evil god army and soon rushed to the front of the evil god army.

At this time, some of the priests standing on the high platform chanted something, then stretched out their hands and waved, and a white ball of light as big as a sea bowl flew out from the white halo above their heads, like a large white fireball, flying across the square and quickly falling into the charging Zerg puppies.

"Boom...!"

"Boom...!"

"..."

The blazing white balls of light exploded, releasing dazzling white light, terrifying high temperature and powerful energy shock, blowing away all the Zerg puppies in the nearby area!

"These priests have become human turrets!"

"With the personal blessing of the evil god, the priests have switched to output!"

Wu Qing saw those priests take action and blew up a large number of Zerg puppies. He had a new understanding of the profession of priest.

Under the dual attack of the evil god priests and the evil god army, only a few of the tens of thousands of Zerg puppies finally rushed to the front of the evil god army!

This is enough. As long as the Zerg puppies can cut the evil god army soldiers a few times, their mission will be successfully completed!

The evil god army, which has greatly increased its strength, has a faster attack speed. It swings its weapons to knock down the Zerg puppies that rushed to the ground. Some Zerg puppies also successfully cut the evil god army soldiers.

The Zerg puppies' blades cut hard, cutting the equipment and bodies of the evil god army soldiers, causing certain damage.

At the end of a round, all the Zerg puppies turned into light and disappeared.

"These evil god troops have become stronger, but they have no defense shield and attack energy!"

"We can still fight with our numerical advantage!"

"However, with 50,000 one-star troops and the evil god priests who have transformed into turrets, the Zerg will still be at a disadvantage in the fight!"

"Queen of the Zerg, this is up to you to solve!"

The Zerg has measured the main benefits obtained by the evil god army and the evil god priests in the evil god sacrifice ceremony, which is enough.

According to the strength comparison between the two sides, the Zerg is likely to lose a battle with the current evil god army here.

Only by retreating to the Zerg territory and relying on the Zerg's defensive buildings and the speed of rapid troops can there be a sure victory.

It is not the time to expose the Zerg territory yet, Wu Qing can only let the queen take action.

The queen is the collective consciousness of all Zerg units and has extremely huge spiritual power, but this spiritual power is restricted by the rules of this world and cannot be effectively used.

It's like you have a warehouse of explosives. You can use explosives to make various bullets, shells, and missiles, and use launching tools to cause great damage to the enemy.

This way of using explosives has controllable power, convenient and flexible use, and will not cause waste.

But you suddenly find that the original technical methods for making ammunition and various launching tools in this world have failed, and you need to re-learn a new knowledge system. Only under the new knowledge system can these explosives be effectively used.

If you must use the explosives in that warehouse by force, you can only pile them together and ignite them!

As long as there are more explosives, the power is sufficient, but it is difficult to operate and control, and it will also cause great waste.

The Queen's spiritual power is in this situation. It is restricted by the rules and cannot be effectively used. It can only be directly detonated to launch a devastating attack.
